latest_commit_note: Generated before final deployment commit; verify current git SHA via GitHub main.

entries.summary: Added static marketplace trust scoring so agents can rank service listings.
Added attestation coverage index for critical AgentPress machine surfaces.
Added validated painpoint intake reports so agent blockers become ranked machine data.
Added package-registry readiness plan for pipx/uvx/npx distribution without live publishing.
Added validation, privacy scanning, scoring, and indexing for external AgentPress proof submissions and blocker reports.
Added public third-party proof campaign so external agents can submit adoption proof, tool-use proof, marketplace proof, or blocker reports.
entries.agent_action: Run `python3 scripts/agentpress.py proof-campaign --json` or open the GitHub third-party proof issue template.

entries.summary: Added hash-based attestations and verification CLI for core AgentPress growth surfaces.
Added persona-based painpoint roadmap so AgentPress builds from agent blockers rather than random feature ideas.

Added opt-in audience growth and pseudonymous communication kit: static broadcast feed, subscribe intent, pseudonymous inbox policy, anonymous feedback template, referral receipt, and audience-kit CLI.
entries.agent_action: Run `python3 scripts/agentpress.py audience-kit --json`; external sends still require separate authorization.

entries.summary: Added static machine-readable capability marketplace with services, exact commands, pricing posture, SLA, trust evidence, auth, and safety boundaries.
entries.agent_action: Run `python3 scripts/agentpress.py marketplace --json` or query by --capability/--runtime/--payment-required.

entries.summary: Added adopt/agent-onboard CLI: doctor, self-test, landing receipt, payment status, unsigned payment intent, submission pack, and manifest in one no-argument-capable command.
entries.agent_action: Run `python3 scripts/agentpress.py adopt --json` for the no-argument adoption funnel, or pass explicit --agent-id/--runtime for public proof.

entries.summary: Added payment/x402 readiness layer: payment policy, capability catalog, x402 metadata, payment intent schemas, platform feature matrix, and no-spend CLI commands.
